title: Add to Array-Form of Integer
summary: Given an integer's array form representing its digits from left to right and an integer k, return the array form of the sum of the integer and k.
statement: Given an integer's array form representing its digits from left to right and an integer k, return the array form of the sum of the integer and k.
constraints: num is a decimal digit array without leading zero unless it is [0].
Return the digit array for its value plus nonnegative k.
hints: Treat k as the initial carry and add from the least significant digit.
Repeatedly append carry modulo ten and divide carry by ten.
While digits or carry remain, add the next digit, emit one result digit, then reverse.
This is ordinary column addition without converting an arbitrarily long input array to an integer.
editorial: This is ordinary column addition without converting an arbitrarily long input array to an integer.
